black-label-trading--lawless.description: Lawless was one of the six blends Black Label Trading Co. launched with, and like the rest of James Brown's range it is rolled in small batches at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí. An Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Toast, cocoa and cashew open the smoke, cream and dried fruit gather in the middle, and caramel richness deepens the close.

thirds.notes: Buttered toast, cocoa and raw cashew over rich earth, with building spice and a floral, cherry-like sweetness.
Cream joins in, the spice grows firmer, and apricot and cherry lend a slightly tart sweetness to the cocoa.
A caramel richness deepens the cream and cocoa, and nicotine makes itself felt near the nub.

black-label-trading--royalty.description: Royalty, one of Black Label Trading Co.'s opening blends, is rolled at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí from an Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper, a Honduran binder and Nicaraguan filler. It stays in the medium range: creamy coffee and cinnamon at first, then cedar, leather and cocoa, and a nutty, creamy finish that suits an afternoon smoke.

thirds.notes: Sweet coffee with cream and cinnamon, a smoky, savoury edge and red pepper; a floral hint appears later.
Cinnamon and spice grow, joined by leather, cedar, cocoa and a first nutty note.
The flavours intensify and the nuttiness turns to peanut butter, wrapped in cream with cinnamon on the finish.

black-label-trading--last-rites.description: Last Rites belongs to Black Label Trading Co.'s first group of six blends and is made at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí. A dark Ecuadorian wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a filler of Nicaraguan and Honduran leaf. Cocoa, pepper and an earthy sweetness carry the smoke, with notes of creamed coffee and cedar; a dense, direct cigar for after dinner.

thirds.notes: Cocoa and pepper vie for the lead over an earthy, sweet maduro base.
No new notes appear: cocoa and sweetness hold while the spice slips into the background.
The flavours thin out and the profile turns flat toward the end.

black-label-trading--salvation.description: Salvation was among the six blends that launched Black Label Trading Co., and the brand now rolls its cigars at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí. An Ecuadorian sun-grown Habano wrapper covers a Honduran binder and Nicaraguan filler. It leans dark and sweet: caramel and chocolate with a charred, barbecue-like smoke, then oak and leather, and dark chocolate with returning spice.

thirds.notes: Caramel and breakfast chocolate with a charcoal, barbecue-like smoke; spice and graham cracker on the nose.
Charred wood and leather take over, dark chocolate builds, and a touch of cinnamon appears late.
Spice returns around dark chocolate, leather and cashew, with a hint of anise and a little more nicotine.

black-label-trading--morphine.description: Morphine is Black Label Trading Co.'s yearly limited release, first offered in 2014 as the brand's seventh blend and made in Estelí. A Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper, in some years doubled with an Ecuadorian maduro leaf, covers a Nicaraguan Habano binder and Nicaraguan-led filler. Espresso, dark chocolate, licorice and leather lead before the smoke settles into earth and pepper.

black-label-trading--santa-muerte.description: Santa Muerte is a limited release from Black Label Trading Co., rolled at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí. The 2019 edition used an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper and binder around a filler of Nicaraguan, Dominican and Mexican San Andrés tobacco. It is rich and quick to change: pepper, dark chocolate and espresso with baking spice, growing creamier as the strength climbs.

black-label-trading--bishop-s-blend.description: Bishop's Blend is an annual limited release from Black Label Trading Co., made at Fabrica Oveja Negra in Estelí. The 2026 edition wraps an Ecuadorian Habano binder and Nicaraguan and Pennsylvania Broadleaf filler in Ecuadorian Connecticut-seed broadleaf maduro. Pepper and dark chocolate set the tone, softening into a creamy, savoury and quietly sweet finish.

black-label-trading--memento-mori.description: Memento Mori from Black Label Trading Co. began as a factory exclusive and is now offered in three sizes. A dark, oily Pennsylvania Broadleaf wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and aged Nicaraguan long filler. The smoke is earthy and rich, with dried dark fruit, bitter cocoa and black pepper, and a light caramel and cinnamon sweetness on the finish.
